title: Open days and study advisory - Master
description: Discover more about USI's Bachelor's and Master's Degrees. The Study Advisory organizes several open days to let you visit the campus, meet students and professors.

blocks.html:
• Overview

  • Open days Master's Degrees

Would you like to discover the Università della Svizzera italiana and our study programmes?
Click on the tab "Open Days Master's Degrees" to know more about our future events.
If you wish to schedule a personalised orientation meeting, contact the Study Advisory Service. You will find the answers to all your questions!

For the 2026/2027 academic year, we are organising several orientation events for our Master's Degrees on our campuses in Lugano and Mendrisio.

We offer different formats of Open Days:

  • During the Master Info Day, you’ll spend half a day at USI. We’ll give you a general introduction to the university and its services, followed by a more specific presentation of the Master’s programme you’re interested in, where you’ll meet the programme director, current students and alumni.
  • The Master Meetings give you the opportunity to sit in on real lectures of the Master’s programme you’re considering, helping you gain a clearer understanding of the content and teaching methods.

You can mark the following dates in your agenda:​

Autumn semester

  • Friday 23 October 2026: Master Info Day ! Registration open – Click here to register !
  • From Monday 2 November 2026 to Wendesday 11 November 2026: Master Meetings (in-person only)​

Spring semester

  • Friday 19 February 2027: Master Info Day – Architecture
  • Friday 26 February 2027: Master Info Day
  • From Wednesday 17 March 2027 to Thursday 25 March 2027: Master Meetings (in-person only)

Advance registration is mandatory to attend all these events. Registration forms for each event will open a few weeks before the event itself.

If you would like to receive an email when registration opens for upcoming events, please sign up using this form (remember to accept all privacy conditions to allow us to contact you!).

Alternatively, you can always book an individual appointment — contact the Study Advisory: you’ll find answers to all your questions!
